comments.author: Juicebox
comments.body:
This Oxford allows you to eat and drink more as it lessens the chance you will get drunk or full

One important thing about completing this thesis is just eating any course meal wont complete it.

You must eat a course meal AND after you eat it, it MUST say The Sailors are happy if not it wont count toward completing thesis

Any course meal that completely restores stamina will work. However here is the one I used in Seville I just kept switching back and forth between the two. It took roughly 50 course meals eaten before I completed thesis. You can run out to sea and back again so you can eat again and try again...

Sherry, Raw ham, Bacahlau Croquets, Tortilla
And
Sherry, Bacahlau Croquets, Chicken Paella,Bacahlau Croquets, Tortilla

comments.author: ThatOneGuy
comments.body:
Eh, you gotta do this quest: The town's top cook
Having Cooking R5 or Wining and Dining R3 is also needed. After that, it'll show up under both 1-star and 2-star buildings, with Full/Drunk Rate Decrease and Food Efficiency Rate skills for a reward on thesis completion. In that order!
